We’re a husband-and-wife art studio creating beautiful illustrations, photo mockups and customisable design kits for creative people and thoughtful brands.

Our work brings an artistic, botanical point of view to the everyday — helping you present your products and spaces in a way that feels true to your style.

Andrey & Olesia
Founders of KOTKOA Studio
